notes.title: WildType 0.0.5 is coming out
notes.content: [p]After Months of working, 0.0.5 version is finally out. 😊[/p][p][/p][p]This version introducing an OS-like desktop-window system.[/p][p]Applications like Textpad and Practice are now separate windows, making multitasking much easier.[/p][p][/p][p]And the retro-90s window style allows you to immerse yourself in a retro and low-key atmosphere and enjoy the pure pleasure of typing.[/p][p][/p][p]Detail Change log:[/p][p][/p][p]Desktop[/p][p]    Icons and desktop colors/wallpapers are customizable[/p][p]    Effect and rating buttons are added to status bar, for users to eaiser manage current state[/p][p][/p][p]Textpad[/p][p]    Added colorscheme[/p][p]    Added search and replace functionality[/p][p]    Added keyboard [/p][p][/p][p]Practice[/p][p]    Now allows user to select from different categories and languages, giving more control over the exercises[/p][p][/p][p]Game[/p][p]    Added a typing game: typing mole, to exercises speed and accuracy[/p][p][/p][p]Effects[/p][p]    Fixed some effect issues[/p][p][/p][p]Applications[/p][p]    Added typing calendar: Track typing activity over the year[/p][p]    Added pomo clock, replace prev notify clock[/p][p]    Added calculator[/p][p]    Added leaderboard (connected to steam leaderboard) for textpad, practice and game[/p][p]    Added happy dual (Test), a dual typing game with steam network[/p][p][/p][p]Input[/p][p]    Improved the internal pinyin input[/p][p]    Fixed some bugs of the internal pinyin input[/p][p]    Supplement the internal pinyin library to the 8105 standard[/p][p]    Added the shuangpin scheme of ZiRanMa and PinYin JiaJia[/p][p][/p][p]Fonts[/p][p]    Added more fonts for users to choose from[/p][p][/p][p]Steam[/p][p]    Added Steam SDK，to uses the functionality of Leaderboard and Networking.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.0.4-fix1:theme_cache
notes.content:
1. add theme cache, so that switching themes no longer lagging
2. doubled the shake amount of the effect-level 'very', so it matches the amount of 0.0.1

notes.title: updates of 0.0.4
notes.content:
In 0.0.4, We have updated many new features and effects

1. New theme system that has dark and light themes
2. Improve effect system and add cursor trail effect
3. Practice mode to make typing practice easy
4. Internal input method added shuangpin-mode for pinyin input
5. more levels for effects, so that easier to switch

and there are more minor updates, you can view it in the software
